title: Bitcoin (BTC) — overview
text:
Bitcoin (BTC) — overview
Bitcoin (BTC) is the first cryptocurrency, described in the white paper "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" published in 2008 by the pseudonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. The network launched on 3 January 2009 with the genesis block. Биткоин (BTC) — первая криптовалюта, запущенная 3 января 2009 года; автор — аноним под псевдонимом Сатоши Накамото.

title: Consensus and technology
text:
Consensus and technology
Bitcoin uses Proof of Work (PoW) with the SHA-256 hashing algorithm. Miners compete to find a valid block hash; the winner adds a block and receives the block subsidy plus transaction fees. The target block time is about 10 minutes, and difficulty adjusts roughly every 2016 blocks (about two weeks). Консенсус — Proof of Work (SHA-256), блок примерно каждые 10 минут, сложность пересчитывается каждые 2016 блоков.

Bitcoin uses the UTXO (unspent transaction output) model. Its scripting language is intentionally limited and not Turing complete. The base layer processes only a few transactions per second, so scaling is done through second-layer solutions such as the Lightning Network (payment channels). Segregated Witness (SegWit, 2017) and Taproot (2021) are major protocol upgrades.

title: Supply and halving
text:
Supply and halving
Maximum supply is hard-capped at 21 million BTC. New coins are issued as block rewards, and the reward is cut in half roughly every 210,000 blocks (about four years) — the halving. Halvings occurred in 2012 (50 → 25 BTC), 2016 (25 → 12.5), 2020 (12.5 → 6.25) and April 2024 (6.25 → 3.125). The last bitcoin is expected to be mined around the year 2140. Максимальная эмиссия — 21 млн BTC; халвинг происходит примерно раз в 4 года и уменьшает награду за блок вдвое.

title: Use cases and risks
text:
Use cases and risks
Main narratives: "digital gold" / store of value, censorship-resistant settlement, and a hedge against inflation. Spot Bitcoin ETFs were approved in the United States in January 2024, increasing institutional access. Risks: high price volatility, regulatory changes, custody and key-loss risk, energy-consumption criticism of PoW, and the long-term question of security funding once block subsidies decline. Bitcoin's fees are paid in BTC; the smallest unit is a satoshi (1 BTC = 100,000,000 sats).

title: Ethereum (ETH) — overview
text:
Ethereum (ETH) — overview
Ethereum is a programmable blockchain proposed by Vitalik Buterin in 2013 and launched on 30 July 2015. Its native currency is ether (ETH). Unlike Bitcoin, Ethereum supports general-purpose smart contracts executed by the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), which enabled DeFi, NFTs, stablecoins and DAOs. Эфириум — блокчейн со смарт-контрактами, запущен в 2015 году; идея Виталика Бутерина. Нативная монета — эфир (ETH).

title: Consensus: Proof of Stake
text:
Consensus: Proof of Stake
On 15 September 2022 Ethereum completed "The Merge", switching from Proof of Work to Proof of Stake (PoS), reducing energy use by about 99.9%. Validators stake 32 ETH to participate in block production and attestation, and can be penalized (slashed) for misbehaviour. Staking yield is roughly in the low single-digit percent per year and varies with network activity. Liquid staking protocols (e.g. Lido, Rocket Pool) issue tokens representing staked ETH. После The Merge (сентябрь 2022) Ethereum работает на Proof of Stake; валидатору нужно 32 ETH.

title: Fees, burning and supply
text:
Fees, burning and supply
Ethereum has no hard supply cap. Since EIP-1559 (London upgrade, August 2021) a base fee is burned on every transaction, so during periods of high network usage more ETH is burned than issued and supply can shrink (deflationary pressure). Transaction fees are paid in "gas", measured in gwei (1 gwei = 10^-9 ETH). Комиссии (gas) платятся в ETH; по EIP-1559 базовая комиссия сжигается.

title: Scaling: Layer 2 and roadmap
text:
Scaling: Layer 2 and roadmap
Ethereum scales mainly through rollups (Layer 2): Optimistic rollups (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base) and ZK-rollups (zkSync, Starknet, Scroll). The Dencun upgrade (March 2024) introduced "blobs" (EIP-4844) that make rollup data cheaper. The roadmap includes further sharding-like data availability improvements, better validator economics and account abstraction.

title: Risks
text:
Risks
Competition from other smart-contract platforms (Solana and others), smart-contract bugs and hacks in applications, regulatory scrutiny of staking, and complexity of the multi-layer ecosystem. ETH price is volatile and often correlated with Bitcoin and overall market sentiment.

title: Blockchain
text:
Blockchain
A blockchain is a distributed ledger where transactions are grouped into blocks linked by cryptographic hashes. It is maintained by many nodes without a central operator. Блокчейн — распределённый реестр транзакций, защищённый криптографией.

title: Proof of Work vs Proof of Stake
text:
Proof of Work vs Proof of Stake
Proof of Work (Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin) secures the network by consuming computing power; miners compete to produce blocks. Proof of Stake (Ethereum, Solana, Cardano) selects validators by the amount of coins they lock as collateral and slashes dishonest ones; it uses far less energy. PoW — безопасность за счёт вычислительной мощности; PoS — за счёт заблокированных монет.

title: Coins vs tokens
text:
Coins vs tokens
A coin is the native asset of its own blockchain (BTC, ETH, SOL). A token is created on top of an existing blockchain through smart contracts (for example ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum or SPL tokens on Solana). Монета имеет собственный блокчейн, токен создаётся поверх чужого.

title: Stablecoins
text:
Stablecoins
Stablecoins aim to track a reference asset, usually USD. Types: fiat-backed (USDT, USDC), crypto-collateralized (DAI) and algorithmic (high-risk; TerraUSD collapsed in May 2022). Risks include reserve transparency, depegging and issuer regulation.

title: Wallets and keys
text:
Wallets and keys
A wallet stores private keys, not coins. The seed phrase (12–24 words) restores all keys; anyone who knows it controls the funds. Hot wallets are connected to the internet; cold (hardware) wallets keep keys offline. Never share your seed phrase or private key. Seed-фраза даёт полный доступ к средствам — никому её не сообщайте.

title: Market metrics
text:
Market metrics
Market capitalization = price × circulating supply. Fully diluted valuation (FDV) = price × maximum supply. 24h volume shows trading activity. All-time high (ATH) is the highest historical price. Bitcoin dominance is BTC's share of total crypto market cap. Рыночная капитализация = цена × количество монет в обращении.

title: DeFi, NFT, Layer 2
text:
DeFi, NFT, Layer 2
DeFi (decentralized finance) offers lending, trading (DEXs like Uniswap) and yield through smart contracts without intermediaries. NFTs are unique tokens representing ownership of digital items. Layer 2 networks process transactions off the main chain to reduce fees while inheriting its security.

title: Common risks and scams
text:
Common risks and scams
Price volatility, leverage liquidations, exchange insolvency (FTX, 2022), rug pulls, phishing, fake airdrops, and "guaranteed returns" schemes. Always verify contract addresses, use official links and diversify. This knowledge base is educational and is not financial advice. Это не финансовая рекомендация.

title: Solana (SOL) — overview
text:
Solana (SOL) — overview
Solana is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain designed by Anatoly Yakovenko; the white paper appeared in 2017 and the mainnet beta launched in March 2020. Its native token is SOL, used for transaction fees, staking and securing the network. Солана — высокопроизводительный блокчейн первого уровня, мейннет запущен в марте 2020 года; токен — SOL.

title: Technology
text:
Technology
Solana combines Proof of Stake with Proof of History (PoH), a cryptographic clock that orders events and helps validators agree on time without heavy communication. Other innovations include Tower BFT consensus, Turbine block propagation, Sealevel parallel transaction execution and Gulf Stream mempool-less forwarding. Smart contracts ("programs") are mostly written in Rust (also C and C++) and run on the Sealevel runtime, not the EVM. Консенсус — PoS + Proof of History; программы пишутся на Rust.

Block time is around 400 milliseconds, and fees are very low (fractions of a cent). Solana is known for high throughput, but it has suffered several network outages and performance degradations, particularly in 2021–2024, which are cited as its main reliability risk. Firedancer, an independent validator client developed by Jump Crypto, aims to improve performance and client diversity.

title: Supply and staking
text:
Supply and staking
SOL has no hard supply cap; it uses an inflationary schedule that started near 8% per year and decreases by 15% annually toward a long-term rate around 1.5%. A portion of fees is burned. Holders can stake SOL with validators for yield, or use liquid staking tokens such as mSOL and jitoSOL. Инфляция SOL убывает со временем; стейкинг даёт доходность.

title: Ecosystem
text:
Ecosystem
Solana hosts DeFi (Jupiter, Raydium, Marinade, Kamino), NFTs (Magic Eden), memecoins launched via platforms like pump.fun, and DePIN projects. Its stablecoin activity (USDC, USDT) is significant. Risks: validator centralization concerns, outages, memecoin-driven speculation, regulatory uncertainty and competition from Ethereum L2s.

Unlike Bitcoin, which primarily functions as digital currency, Ethereum operates as a programmable global computer where developers can create any type of decentralized service.

It distinguishes itself by scaling globally without the use of complex sharding or multiple layers, instead maintaining a single, unified ledger to avoid liquidity fragmentation. This architecture allows it to process thousands of transactions per second with sub-second finality, often at a cost of less than a penny per transaction.

BNB is the native utility token of the BNB Chain ecosystem, acting as a multi-chain asset that powers decentralized applications and facilitates value exchange across its network. It serves as the primary asset for paying transaction gas and smart contract deployment fees while providing users with tiered fee discounts on the Binance exchange. The project’s main value proposition lies in its unified multi-chain architecture, which integrates a smart contract platform, a Layer 2 scaling solution, and a decentralized data storage network into a cohesive settlement and data availability layer.

The network operates on a Proof of Staked Authority consensus mechanism, utilizing a group of 21 active validators known as the Cabinet to verify transactions and produce blocks every 3 seconds. Validators are elected daily based on the amount of BNB staked or delegated to them, and the system employs fast finality and slashing penalties to maintain security and integrity. To manage its long-term economy, the project uses a programmatic dual-burn strategy that permanently removes tokens through real-time fee destruction and quarterly buybacks.

XRP is a decentralized digital asset and the native token of the XRP Ledger, a Layer 1 blockchain designed for high-performance global payments. Its primary value proposition is offering a fast, cost-effective alternative to traditional banking systems by enabling near-instant cross-border settlements that finalize in three to five seconds. By serving as a neutral bridge asset between different fiat currencies, it helps financial institutions lower liquidity costs and eliminates the need for pre-funded accounts.
